quizName:
Hardest Questions in Mississippi
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: If you have an argument with another person and feel angry, what should you do?

options.text: Play the radio loudly while driving so you won't think about the argument.
Wait a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Drive on the interstate to release your anger.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions make it harder to drive safely. If you are angry, upset, worried, or sad, take time to calm down before you drive. You need to focus on the road.

questions.question: The traffic light is green, but a police officer signals you to stop. What should you do?

options.text: Do what the car in front of you does.

questions.explanation: Always obey a police officer's signals, even if they go against traffic signals, signs, or road markings.

questions.question: A school bus has stopped with its stop arm out and red lights flashing. What should you do?

options.text: Stop completely and wait until the bus moves.
Honk your horn and pass the bus on its left side.
Keep driving when you think the children have finished getting off.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and wait until the bus moves.
questions.explanation: Stop your vehicle when you see a school bus with its stop arm extended and red lights flashing. Do not move until the arm goes in and the lights turn off.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that turning in the direction of the arrow (right) is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet pavement can be slippery and dangerous. Slow down when you see this sign because your car may skid and it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, what is the best thing to do?

options.text: Stop to rest or let someone else drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or let someone else drive.
questions.explanation: Tiredness makes you less alert and slows your reaction time. This makes driving unsafe. The best solution is to stop and rest or change drivers.

questions.question: A railroad crossing gate is coming down. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up and cross before the gate closes completely.

questions.explanation: Stop at a railroad crossing when the gate is lowering. It is dangerous to try to go around it or cross before it is fully raised.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: At a crosswalk, what must you do?

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at crosswalks. You must stop for them, whether the crosswalk is marked or not.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with lowered gates and flashing lights?

options.text: Drive around the crossing gates if you can't see a train.
Come to a complete stop well behind the gates, wait for the tracks to clear, and proceed once the gates are lifted.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop well behind the gates, wait for the tracks to clear, and proceed once the gates are lifted.
questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing with lowered gates. It is illegal to drive around them. Wait until the gates are lifted before proceeding.

questions.question: Like alcohol and drugs, drowsiness can:

options.text: Help you to be a better driver.

questions.explanation: Drowsiness slows your reaction time, decreases awareness, and impairs judgment, just like alcohol and drugs do.

questions.question: What should you do if you encounter an aggressive driver?
questions.explanation: The safest action is to get out of their way. Never compete with aggressive drivers.

questions.question: This sign warns you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction.

questions.question: If you become drowsy while driving, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop at the nearest rest stop or service area to take a nap, stretch, or change drivers. Caffeine pills are not a safe substitute for rest.

questions.question: Who can use handicap parking spaces?

options.text: Only drivers with the appropriate license plate or hanging tag.
Anyone, but only if all other spaces are full.
People who are not feeling well.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only drivers with the appropriate license plate or hanging tag.
questions.explanation: Only people with disabilities can use handicap parking spaces. You must display the proper license plate or hanging tag to park there.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers to watch for people, animals, or vehicles that may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign forbids right turns. You cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: In a vehicle with airbags, where should children age 12 and under sit?

options.text: The bed of a pick-up truck.

questions.explanation: Airbags can hurt children. Children age 12 and under should always sit in the back seat of a vehicle with airbags.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are forbidden.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disability placards.

questions.question: What should you do if you must stop suddenly on an interstate?

options.text: Sound your horn at passing cars to get their attention.
Get out of your vehicle and flag down the first vehicle that passes.
Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle, if you can.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle, if you can.
questions.explanation: If you must stop on the shoulder, turn on your emergency flashers and stay in your vehicle. Standing or walking on an interstate is very dangerous because of fast traffic.

questions.question: This sign warns of what type of road feature?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to what is ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a pedestrian with a white cane or guide dog?

options.text: Honk so they know to clear the way.

questions.explanation: If a blind person is crossing a street, be careful and courteous. Let them cross safely before you go.

questions.question: Where should drivers watch most carefully for children?
questions.explanation: Watch carefully for children everywhere they gather. This includes schools, playgrounds, and residential neighborhoods where children may be playing in the street.
